description:
One mobile plan in full, by the id search_mobile_plans returned: every contract option with
promos, crossed-out and announced prices, order fees and the total over the commitment, data
roaming outside the EU, calls and SMS to the EU, and PriceBee's overview of who the plan suits.
Use it when the user asks about a specific plan or wants the fine print before choosing.

language.description: The user's language for the plan overview: en (default), lt, ru, lv or ee.
